concept.title: Launch Control (For GT)
concept.shortdesc: Launch control is a function that applies pre-torque in a stationary state to prepare for launch and delivers a punchy acceleration feel during takeoff.

section.title: Launch Control settings
section.p: When the vehicle is in DRIVE READY state, tap SettingsVehicleDrive ModeLaunch Control from the infotainment system screen.

li.p: Step on the brake pedal over a certain level and then depress the accelerator pedal lightly. Launch Control Ready warning message will appear on the instrument cluster once Launch Control is ready to activate.
Once Launch Control is ready, pre-torque will be automatically initiated.
Start driving after releasing the brake pedal within 8 seconds.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: Launch Control will be activated when all of the following conditions are satisfied:

li.p: Drive mode is in GT (MY DRIVE mode: SPORT+)
ESC is in SPORT or OFF
Steering wheel is in straight position
High voltage battery condition is normal (not overheated, not too cold, and not low state of charge)
Launch Control will be canceled once you release the accelerator pedal.
If you want to use Launch Control again, you must cool down the vehicle for more than approximately 2 minutes. (If the ready state exceeds 8 seconds, it is considered as used.)
Launch control use is restricted when the vehicle’s Motor Control Unit (MCU) is overheated or when the battery is not in a normal condition (overheated, too cold, or low state of charge).
Launch control may also be restricted when driver assistance systems, including vehicle safety features, are operating.
Launch control is a launch assist feature and does not increase the vehicle’s actual acceleration performance.
